$comment: Styling contract — layer 2: the tie. Which component-group vocabulary each
AUTHORED, not inferred. Declarations are data; inference is code. These
survive a failed inference attempt and become the ground truth any later
inference engine gets validated against. Inference is deferred, possibly
Every entry carries a group SET, never a single group. Verified on the real
input/select/label AND button AND app-usage-gauge — one component spanning
four groups. Mono-group-per-template inference cannot describe that.
'groups' is what the component may style from. Order carries no meaning.
'why' exists where the tie is non-obvious — it is intent, not documentation.
Coverage is partial by design: this is the shared/ tree, which is the code
that governs how everything else looks.

signal-list.why: The composite that disproves inference. Table shell, inline filter inputs and page-size select, row/header action buttons, embedded usage-gauge cells, per-row status, and column/overflow menus.

signal-detail.why: Key/value rows read as a table but sit in a card surface.

stepper.why: Rail and step indicators are stepper's own; every step body hosts form fields and the next/back buttons are ordinary buttons.

dialog-confirm.why: Confirm dialogs host an optional input (typed confirmation) alongside the action buttons.

sidepanel-preview.why: Side panels are dialog surfaces that enter from an edge.

list-sub-nav.why: Belongs to the list it filters, but renders as page-level sub-navigation.

schema-widget-renderer.why: Renders arbitrary schema-driven inputs; everything it emits is a form control.

editable-display-value.why: Reads as a value until edited, then becomes an input plus confirm/cancel.

code-block.why: Copyable CLI/env-var widget — the copy affordance is a button. Merging with markdown-preview into one component is decided but not yet done.

markdown-preview.why: Decided: merges with code-block (markdown mode + raw mode). Raw mode is an injection boundary — interpolated org/space names must be escaped, never parsed as markdown.

json-viewer.why: Decided: DROPPED in favour of read-only Monaco (3 consumers). Declared so the tie stays honest until the component is actually gone.

undeclared.$comment: Present in shared/ but deliberately carrying no tie, with the reason. An empty tie is a claim; absence is not.
undeclared.custom-material: Angular Material module wiring, renders nothing of its own.
